title: I am convinced there is another world out there. A real world.
content: Whether Mall World is just a state of hypnosis or a real place is up to debate. But there is (for sure) a world beyond that. I think we can only scratch the surface by dreaming casually. There is a way to go deeper with lucid dreaming and other techniques. I have had some very interesting (and creepy) experiences myself. I don't want to reveal what I found (it was scary af) but if you want to try for yourself, do this: In your dream journal: - record your waking life day as if it were a dream (so everything disjointed, pretend you jumped from place to place and sudden scenes appeared seemingly out of nowhere and describe only some details as if they were random - eg someone you saw in a shop, or maybe an animal you spotted. ) - record your dream as if it were waking life (write it out as if everything had real structure and what happened was the next natural course of events. Write as though all of your actions had real purpose and decision-making behind them) Let me know what you find. I'd be interested to hear if you find the same thing I did 💀 I got the same result in my dreams consistently and eventually had to stop because it was getting out of hand. I won't say what it was as I don't want to influence your experience by power of suggestion. Btw. Only do this if you're not easily scared.
